name: duology
description: Claude Code plugins for designing, building, testing and shipping apps on iPhone Duo, the foldable iPhone with an outer and an inner display. Community project, not affiliated with Apple.

plugins.name: duology
plugins.description: Foundation for iPhone Duo apps: Xcode 27.1 and simulator setup, layout across the fold, vertical bars, state that survives fold and unfold, and scenes and windows. Adds /duo-doctor.

plugins.name: duology-design
plugins.description: Design for iPhone Duo: design tokens, eight layout patterns, every pose, fold transitions, ergonomics, accessibility, two people on one screen, and a 15-point review of screenshots and Figma frames. Adds the duo-design-reviewer agent and /duo-review.

plugins.name: duology-recipes
plugins.description: App recipes for iPhone Duo. /duo-new creates a project that builds and runs on the iPhone Duo simulator. Recipes: a two-player game and a media player.

plugins.name: duology-ship
plugins.description: Test and ship for iPhone Duo: duo-lint (the fold linter), an opt-in lint hook, tests on the Duo simulator, screenshots closed, open, in book pose and in tabletop (duo-pose-matrix), /duo-audit and /duo-poses.

plugins.name: duology-features
plugins.description: iOS 27 features on iPhone Duo's two displays: Foundation Models, App Intents, the camera, media, reading, games, the iOS 27 SwiftUI changes, and widgets, Live Activities and Controls. Skills land one by one in v0.3.
